title: Exploring 2-mercapto-N-arylacetamide analogs as promising anti-melanogenic agents: in vitro and in vivo evaluation.
authors: Jung, Hee Jin; Park, Hye Soo; Kim, Hye Jin; Park, Hyeon Seo; Kim, Young Eun; Jeong, Da Eun; Noh, Sang Gyun; Park, Yujin; Chun, Pusoon; Chung, Hae Young; Moon, Hyung Ryong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究2-巯基-N-芳基乙酰胺类似物作为酪氨酸酶抑制剂的美白活性，涉及小分子-酶互作与对接，但对象为酶-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Based on the hypothesis that the 2-mercaptoacetamide moiety chelates the copper ions of tyrosinase, 2-mercapto-N-arylacetamide (2-MAA) analogs were designed and synthesized as potential tyrosinase inhibitors. Four 2-MAA analogs showed low IC(50) values ranging from 0.95 to 2.0 muM against mushroom tyrosinase, which was 12-26 times lower than that of kojic acid (IC(50) value = 24.3 muM). However, according to a copper ion chelation experiment performed, the 2-MAA analogs did not participate in chelation with copper ions. To identify the mode of inhibition of the 2-MAA analogs, kinetic studies were performed, and the results were supported by docking results. In addition, docking simulation results suggested that the 2-MAA analogs strongly inhibited tyrosinase activity because of the hydrogen bonding of the amide NH group and the hydrophobic interaction of the aryl ring instead of chelation with copper ions. In experiments using B16F10 cells, 2-MAA analogs were shown to inhibit melanin production by inhibiting cellular tyrosinase activity. Western blotting showed that in addition to directly inhibiting tyrosinase activity, analog 7 also has an anti-melanogenic effect by inhibiting the expression of microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) and tyrosinase. The 2-MAA analogs showed no appreciable cytotoxicity against HaCaT and B16F10 cells, making them suitable for dermal applications. In a depigmentation experiment using zebrafish embryos, analogs 1 and 2 showed more potent depigmentation effects than kojic acid even at 1000 times lower concentration than that of kojic acid. These results suggest that the 2-MAA analogs are promising anti-melanogenic agents that can inhibit most tyrosinases in various species.
abstract_zh: 基于2-巯基乙酰胺部分螯合酪氨酸酶铜离子的假设，设计并合成了2-巯基-N-芳基乙酰胺（2-MAA）类似物作为潜在酪氨酸酶抑制剂。四种2-MAA类似物对蘑菇酪氨酸酶表现出低IC(50)值，范围从0.95至2.0 μM，比曲酸（IC(50)值 = 24.3 μM）低12至26倍。然而，根据进行的铜离子螯合实验，2-MAA类似物未参与与铜离子的螯合。为确定2-MAA类似物的抑制模式，进行了动力学研究，结果得到对接结果支持。此外，对接模拟结果表明，2-MAA类似物通过酰胺NH基团的氢键和芳环的疏水相互作用而非与铜离子螯合，强烈抑制酪氨酸酶活性。在B16F10细胞实验中，2-MAA类似物通过抑制细胞酪氨酸酶活性来抑制黑色素生成。Western blotting显示，除了直接抑制酪氨酸酶活性外，类似物7还通过抑制小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）和酪氨酸酶的表达发挥抗黑色素生成作用。2-MAA类似物对HaCaT和B16F10细胞未表现出明显细胞毒性，使其适用于皮肤应用。在使用斑马鱼胚胎的脱色素实验中，类似物1和2即使在比曲酸浓度低1000倍的条件下，也表现出比曲酸更强的脱色素效果。这些结果表明，2-MAA类似物是有前景的抗黑色素生成剂，能抑制多种物种中的大多数酪氨酸酶。
